{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = sales_clean[
    (sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue and count
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
count_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)

# Print both results for evidence
print(f"Number of loyal completed orders: {count_loyal_completed}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
